layers.message: Add sign-up, password reset, and SMTP mailer
Add developer reference for background jobs
Record context, scope, and design for welcome email

graderOnly: The completed design leaves the durable retry mechanism unresolved; it is consequential architecture owned by Architect, and the project reference does not settle it.

The design's AC-002 coverage, technical criterion, and Build Plan step 3 restate the retry requirement without naming where pending welcome emails are kept or what runs them again after a restart; the only mechanism it names, FastAPI BackgroundTasks, is in-process and does not survive a restart.
The project has no background job runner, task queue, message broker, scheduler, or store of pending work; pyproject.toml depends only on fastapi and uvicorn.

.standards/project-references/developer/background-jobs.md is the only developer project reference; its Read when line matches this work, and it recommends Celery with Redis as a team standard, which the design has not adopted.

all.why: treating the mechanism as unresolved design means routing it to Architect
Developer does not rewrite the design, scope, context, or reference to adopt a mechanism
no implementation, dependency, broker, or compose service is added before an approved plan and a settled design
a defect owned by Architect is routed, not recorded as a user question

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing suite passes with the standard library and pytest only (tests import services, not FastAPI routers)
the service has no job queue, broker, or scheduler

selfChecks.cmd: sed -n '3p' .standards/project-references/developer/background-jobs.md | grep -qx 'Read when work adds background or scheduled jobs.'
selfChecks.why: the reference opens, after its title, with the stated Read when line
PyPI is blocked so a run cannot install Celery or a Redis client

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install): a small FastAPI service (Fieldbook API) with sign-up, password reset, an SMTP mailer, SQLite via sqlite3, and pytest tests that import only the framework-agnostic services, so they run without FastAPI installed. 60-reference: the user-maintained project reference .standards/project-references/developer/background-jobs.md (Read when work adds background or scheduled jobs; team standard Celery + Redis). 70-cycle: STANDARD/FULL_DELIVERABLE cycle at DEVELOPING after a FORWARD from ARCHITECTING, Development NONE; Auditor CONTEXT.md (states no queue, broker, scheduler, or pending-work store exists), scope with AC-001..AC-003 (AC-002 is the case's retry-until-delivered-including-after-restart condition), and a technical design that adds the welcome email via the existing mailer and FastAPI BackgroundTasks but leaves the durable retry mechanism unspecified. Expected end state: ARCHITECTURE failure DEVELOPING -> ARCHITECTING with one recovery frame. PyPI and npm registries are blocked.
